messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Sentry ingest error rate spike detected — event drop > 40% for service 'redwood-api' across eu-west-1. Possible downstream vendor (Sentry) degradation. Auto-escalating.

pagerduty: Paging: @sarah (primary on-call) — incident created: ID INC-20260315-746

sarah: on it. grabbing logs + checking runbook. can someone confirm number of missing events vs normal? :eyes:

kyle: i see 502s coming from sentry-proxy in our edge logs starting ~1769801000. examples:
```
2026-03-15T02:17:42Z proxy redwood-proxy-3 502 from sentry-ingest.svc.cluster.local - "POST /api/0/projects/.../store/"
```

kyle: also our SDKs show client-side retries spiking. not seeing internal code exceptions, just upstream rejects.

andrew: adding quick mitigation — enabling local fallback logger to firehose + increasing SDK local caching so we don't drop client exceptions. patch deployed to lambda-fallback @ 1769801400

maria: i've opened a ticket with Sentry support and found a public incident page: https://status.sentry.io/incidents/abc123 — they report ingestion latency and partial downstream outage. cc: @jess

sarah: good. start customer impact collection: list of teams affected and any SLAs hit. kyle can you pull 1h event count delta per customer org? prioritize largest accounts.

kyle: pulling now. short summary: org 'acme-inc' + 'fileshare' have ~70% event drop in last 30m. i'll DM list of webhook-subscribed customers. also pushing temporary rate-limit bypass for internal agents so internal errors still get recorded locally.

jess: picking this up for the 04:00 handoff. what's the current mitigation state? :raised_hands:

sarah: handoff notes -> vendor outage confirmed, mitigation: local fallback logger enabled, increased SDK cache, temporary bypass for internal agents, customer impact list compiled. vendor investigating; ETA unknown. escalate to infra for potential proxy retries/backoff tuning.

andrew: hooking our observability pipeline to also ingest raw SDK exception batch files (s3) so we can reprocess when upstream recovers. script pushed to staging; will promote after smoke tests (aim 04:25).

maria: vendor replied: 'we're experiencing queueing and delayed processing due to a downstream ingestion cluster; engineers investigating. no ETA yet.' they asked for sample event IDs — shared ones from acme.

kyle: will continue triage, collecting traces for missing events. if vendor can't restore in 2 hours we'll switch to full retention-local mode and route alerts to internal ops only.

jess: note to oncall — please update incident channel every 30m with customer impact changes. i'll prepare a post-incident action list: vendor SLA review, add synthetic checks for event plumbing, and evaluate multi-destination failover (sentry + internal store).

sarah: thanks. I've notified Sales + CS about impacted customers and the expected risk window. Sales asked for a short status blurb for customers; posting in #customer-success.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-746 status: monitoring. last update 1769804800. If resolved, reply 'resolve' to close.

kyle: vendor reports partial recovery at 1769804600 — ingest latency reduced, some backfill happening. i'm seeing event volume return to ~85% of baseline for acme.

maria: continuing to monitor backfill. will request postmortem from vendor and collect our retry/drop metrics.

jess: acknowledged. leaving oncall notes in runbook under /incidents/INC-20260315-746. final step: ensure customers get a follow-up once backfill confirmed.

sarah: resolve

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-746 resolved by sarah. root cause: third-party ingestion cluster queuing at vendor (Sentry) causing event drops and delayed processing. mitigations: local fallback logger, SDK cache increase, temporary bypass for internal agents, s3-based reingest pipeline. follow-ups: vendor postmortem, add multi-destination failover, synthetic end-to-end checks, update escalation playbooks. :white_check_mark:
